The '''Mining Guild Freighter''' was a modified type of [[Darius G-class freighter|''Darius G''-class freighter]] that was active during the [[Imperial Era]] and the [[New Republic Era]]. During the age of the [[Galactic Empire]], the Mining Guild Freighter was used by the [[Pyke Syndicate]] and [[Hutt Clan]] as a [[transport]] and [[warship]]. Later in the [[New Republic Era]], many [[freighter]]s formed part of the [[Citizens' Fleet]] that participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]].

==Characteristics==
The Mining Guild Freighter<ref name="Kids">{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Ship in the Star Wars Sequel Trilogy|video=bb3vhWXClTY|nolive=1}}</ref> was a modified version of the [[Darius G-class freighter|''Darius G''-class freighter]]. The [[freighter]] was equipped with three [[sublight engine]]s mounted triangularly, a [[hyperdrive]] and had external cargo holds on the port and starboard sides. The [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] was located on the bow of the ship,<ref name="Outlaws" /> and bore a physical resemblance to the bow of a [[Consular-class light cruiser|''Consular''-class space cruiser]].<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref> It was armed with at least two twin [[laser cannon]]s, which were located below the bridge on either side.<ref name="Outlaws" />

==History==
[[File:Mining_Guild_Freighter.png|thumb|left|220px|Many Mining Guild Freighters joined the Citizens' Fleet.]]
The freighter was active during the [[Imperial Era]], seeing service with civilians,<ref name="Outlaws" /> the [[Mining Guild]],<ref name="Kids" /> and the [[Pyke Syndicate]]. The [[Pyke]]s utilized the ship in combat in support of their criminal operations.<ref name="Outlaws" /> Later during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], many of these [[starship]]s joined the [[Citizens' Fleet]] that was assembled by [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] to aid the Resistance against the [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] of the [[Sith Eternal]] during the [[Battle of Exegol]] alongside standard ''Darius G''-class ships.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mining Guild Freighter was first seen in [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']]<ref name="Episode IX" /> and identified as such in the clip "A Final Alliance" behind the scenes featurette that came with the [[Wikipedia:Target|Target]] exclusive of the home video.<ref name="io9">{{WebCite|url=https://io9.gizmodo.com/see-how-star-wars-most-impressive-fleet-was-created-in-1842223160|text=See How Star Wars' Most Impressive Fleet Was Created in This Exclusive Rise of Skywalker Clip|work=[https://io9.gizmodo.com Gizmodo]|date=2020-03-10|archivedate=20200311135740}}</ref>
